svg.aria-label: Animated walkthrough of the Motorola sales dashboard: KPI cards, five visuals and three slicers filtering instantly
svg.title: Animated walkthrough of the Motorola sales dashboard: KPI cards, five visuals and three slicers filtering instantly
svg.text: LIVE WALKTHROUGH · MOTOROLA SALES · POWER BI

g.text: Total sales, quantity, average and transactions sit at the top, so the headline numbers read in
City-wise transactions on a map: bigger bubbles mean more transactions, so strong and weak
Units sold over time turns the sales log into a trend line, so peaks and dips are easy to spot.
Sales by model ranks the mobile models against each other, so the best seller is the tallest
The payment split shows each method's share of transactions at a glance.
Customer ratings sit beside the sales, so volume and satisfaction can be read together.
Pick a month and every card and chart redraws instantly.
Narrow to one model and the KPIs, map, trend and ratings all follow.
Add a payment method and the same dashboard goes one level deeper, with no new report needed.
